pieces.Text: [not implemented as temp bonus]At 4th level when an ectoplasmatist manifests her spiritual lash ability, tendrils of ectoplasmic material envelop her body, granting her a +4 armor bonus to AC. At 12th level, the ectoplasmatist's armor bonus to AC increases to +6 and is treated as ghost touch armor. This ability replaces spiritual interference and greater spiritual interference.
